collection.description: A child tries to copy an elder's clapping pattern.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a child, tries to copy an elder's clapping pattern. The rhythm slowly draws more listeners.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a child, tries to copy an elder's clapping pattern. A shy participant joins in when nobody makes a fuss.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a child, tries to copy an elder's clapping pattern. The music continues until the stars appear.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), a child, tries to copy an elder's clapping pattern. (Name1) misses a beat and laughs before trying again.
